Extra maps, weapons and modes for this install\'s game version: their .ff, .pak and .bik files are copied into the game folder. Script mods (Modern Warfare 3) go in the game folder\'s mods folder, one folder per mod with its .gsc scripts, and run when mods.txt there lists the folder\'s name; remove the line to turn a mod off. Plugins for the console are left alone.

Title Update 6, which mods need, as its own app beside this one (MW2 Campaign TU6 / MW2 Multiplayer TU6) on the releases page. TU6 plays only with TU6, never with this disc-version (TU0) build. The TU6 app installs from the same disc, then downloads the update itself.
The disc-version build, which phones and crossplay started with, as its own app beside this one on the releases page. It plays only with disc-version copies, never with this title-update one.
Same-version rule: TU0 plays only with TU0, TU6 only with TU6.
Pick an entry: its details show here, and choosing it acts at once.
Online through a relay, on the local network, or split screen. Network and voice chat are in Settings.
Online through a relay, on the local network, or split screen. Bots are the entry below; unlocks, match options, network and voice chat are in Settings.
Online through a relay, on the local network, or split screen. Bots are the entry below; the network is in Settings.

Computer players for multiplayer. They join the matches this device hosts: System Link, Create Game, or a private match. They do nothing in a match somebody else hosts. Choose how many and how good here, then start Multiplayer.
Bots (in the matches this device hosts)
The campaign is ready.\nThe multiplayer\'s executable is not in the game folder yet: install from your disc image once more. Only what is missing is copied.
Ready to play.\nThe game files are in %1$s.
The game files are not installed yet.\n\nThis app contains no game data. You supply your own copy: a disc image of the game you own, or a folder with its files in it.
The runtime could not be loaded:\n%1$s

Point this at a disc image (.iso) of your own copy, or at a folder holding the files from one. Everything needed is copied into the app\'s own storage and checked as it goes; about 7 GB of free space is wanted.
Cancelled. What was copied is kept, so starting again carries on from there.
The install is still running. Leaving now stops it; it can be carried on later.
There is not enough free space: %1$s free, about 7 GB needed.
No errors or warnings in this run.
and %1$d more, counted but not shown
Sharing sends the whole log, not this summary.

The Files app hands over a document rather than a path, so the file is copied into this app first: %1$s now, and about 7 GB again for the installed game. %2$s is free.\n\nIf space is tight, use “Browse the phone’s storage” instead — it reads the file where it lies.

The Files app hands over a document rather than a path, so the file is copied into this app first. A disc image is several gigabytes, and the installed game needs about 7 GB more.\n\nIf space is tight, use “Browse the phone’s storage” instead — it reads the file where it lies.
Android only lets an app read files outside its own folder once you allow it. Without that, put the disc image in Android/data/%1$s/files and pick it from there.

Adreno phones can run Mesa\'s Turnip driver, which is often much quicker than the one the phone shipped with, and sometimes renders things the shipped one gets wrong. Import the driver\'s zip archive as it was downloaded; it is unpacked into the app\'s own storage.
That archive does not look like a driver: it has no meta.json naming the library inside it.
That driver is not for this phone (arm64 is needed).
Vulkan %1$s, for Android API %2$d and later

How many pixels are actually drawn, as a share of the screen. The display scales the result up, which costs nothing. This is the single biggest thing a weaker phone can be given; 60 to 75 percent looks close to the original console.
Vulkan internal render scale (MW2_SCALE). Multiplies the title\'s base framebuffer dimensions: 1x native, 2x (supersampled), 3x (high-end). Higher multipliers require significant GPU horsepower.

How soon soldiers, vehicles and props change to their simpler models as they get further away: Reduced at half the console\'s distance, Low at a quarter. Faster wherever many of them are in view. Nothing disappears sooner, and it changes nothing for the other players in a match.
85° is recommended for ultrawide 20:9 mobile displays. (65° was original 16:9 console FOV).
Screen held at %1$d Hz by the system: %1$d FPS, not %2$d. See the launcher.
The screen is held at %1$d Hz by the system, so the game will show %1$d frames a second under its FPS limit of %2$d. Set the screen to %2$d Hz in the system\'s display settings.

On an AYN handheld: turn on Settings \u203a Display \u203a Smooth Display, or the refresh rate tile in the quick settings (swipe down from the top). The dual-screen assistant can turn it off again after a restart.

The shadows the sun casts cost a fifth or more of a frame. Chosen for this device leaves them out on a Snapdragon 865-class chip, and in Modern Warfare 3 wherever the FPS limit is above 60, which is nearer held without them; On keeps them at a lower frame rate.
Texture memory: chosen for this phone
How much the texture cache may hold before it starts letting go of what has not been drawn for a while. Left alone, the runtime picks a figure from the memory this phone has.
Turn this off to ignore controllers entirely. Some phones report an accessory, or their own sensors, as a gamepad with a stick that is not centred, which makes the character walk on its own.
Evens out a finger\'s jitter on glass. Too much and aiming feels like it is on ice.
The on-screen pad is edited in the game: pause and choose “Edit controls”.
The files stay on the phone; the app simply stops using them, and the next install can point somewhere else.

Extra maps, weapons and modes for this install\'s game version. Choose the extracted folder: its .ff, .pak and .bik files are copied into the game folder. Scripts and plugins are reported and left alone — this port runs no plugin system.
Installed %1$d file(s) into the game folder.%2$s
That folder holds nothing to install: no .ff, .pak or .bik files.
Shader cache cleared. Shaders rebuild as you play.

A controller is attached, so a second player can join: Spec Ops co-op and split-screen multiplayer take a second player through the game\u2019s sign-in screen.\n\nHeads-up: two viewports cost frames. Expect dips below 60 FPS, a hot phone, and fast battery drain — lower the display resolution first on weaker devices.

Compiles every recorded pipeline before the title screen instead of warming them up during play. Boot takes minutes on a cold cache and the phone gets warm, but there is almost no in-game shader stutter left afterwards. Off means the quick 2-second boot with background warmup.

Avoids freezes the first time a map is played; some objects may appear a few seconds late while their shaders compile. Off compiles each shader the moment it is first drawn, which can freeze the game briefly.

Every weapon, attachment, camouflage, reticle, proficiency, perk, piece of equipment, death streak, strike package streak, title and emblem can be chosen whatever the rank, and there are fifteen custom classes. Only this device reads them so: nothing is written to the stats, and off shows what was really earned again. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Extra camouflages, listed below Gold in Create a Class beside the game\'s own. See the packs and who made them, switch one off, or add a PC camouflage mod you downloaded.

Computer players that join every match this device hosts (System Link, Create Game, or a private match), and leave to make room when a player joins. They do nothing in a match somebody else hosts. Each one costs the host some speed, so start with a few. Takes effect the next time the game starts; the launcher\'s Bots entry sets the same.

For the matches this device hosts: everybody in them plays by these, and a match somebody else hosts is played by that host\'s. Game Setup in the game has the rest, and now shows its Alternate Modes (Gun Game, Infected, One in the Chamber, Juggernaut, Team Juggernaut, Drop Zone). They take effect the next time the game starts.
Vote for the next map after my matches

When a System Link or private match this device hosts is over, three maps and game types appear at the lower left and every player picks one with the Tactical, Use or Lethal button (LB, X, RB). The winner loads with everyone still in the match; nobody goes back to a menu. End Game in the pause menu ends it as before. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Online: everyone on the relay server
Online and LAN both show other players\u2019 games in the game\u2019s System Link menu: host one there, or join one from its list. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
The server Online plays through (port 3074 when none is given). No password is needed. Left empty, Online plays on this WiFi network, as LAN does.

Opens the game\u2019s Xbox LIVE menu. The game also asks its publisher\u2019s servers there, which this app does not reach, so expect errors: this is for testing. Leave it off to play; System Link needs no sign-in.

Talk to and hear the other players in a match. Turning it on asks for the microphone. What you say is sent to the other players through the relay server, not encrypted, as the console sent it. Headphones avoid echo. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
On: you are heard only while the on-screen Talk button is held. Off: the microphone is open for the whole match, for playing on a controller with the touch controls hidden.
Voice chat needs the microphone permission.
The name other players on the network see (15 characters at most). Left empty, it is this device\u2019s own: its model and four characters that tell it from another of the same model.
The name other players see in lobbies and on the scoreboard. You can change it later in Settings.
When another player on the network invites this phone to their lobby, join without asking. Off means invites are only logged.
Which connection sessions invite to: a name or address piece (WiFi, wlan0, 192.168.1). Needed with a VPN and WiFi at once, so guests are told a door they can reach.
Nobody heard on the network yet — host a lobby on the other machine first, on the same WiFi.
%1$s: %2$d file(s) changed. Restart the match to play on them.
This install is build %1$d, the release carries build %2$d.\n\nIt installs over this one: your game files, saves and settings are kept.
The download failed. Open the release page instead.
The game ends now. Anything the game itself has not saved is lost.
The runtime library would not load:\n%1$s
The game files are not installed. Install them from the launcher first.
The runtime would not start. The log has the details.
The game code is not on this device: it is made from your own disc.\nOn your PC, run setup\\setup.cmd with this device connected over USB.

The game code on this device does not match this version of the app: %1$s.\n\nBuild it again: on your PC, update the project folder (git pull) and run setup\\setup.cmd -GameOnly with this device connected over USB. Your game files and saves are kept.
Running. Leaving the app does not end the game.
Touch a control to pick it up. Drag to move it, pinch to resize.
%1$s — drag to move, pinch to resize
Hidden controls are shown faintly here so they can be turned back on.
Every control goes back where it started, at its original size.
